data.one_liner: Simple API to show in‑app notifications with optional leading/ending widgets
data.what_it_does: Provides a singleton that can be initialized in the app builder and used to display transient notifications. You can customize text, colors, fonts, shadows and animations, and add status callbacks.
use_when: You need quick, lightweight in‑app messages without push notifications
You want to customize the look of notifications beyond the default toast
You prefer a single method call to show a notification
avoid_when: You need persistent local or push notifications
You require platform‑specific notification channels or scheduling
strengths: Easy to set up, no native code required
weaknesses: No support for background or scheduled notifications
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, call InAppNotifications.init() in MaterialApp builder, then use InAppNotifications.show()

alternatives.name: fluttertoast
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides simple toast messages with fewer customization options

alternatives.name: overlay_support
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers more advanced overlay notifications with built‑in animations
